properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated Friday, [likely February 10, 1933], on stationery from the Canadian Pacific Steamship Lines, S.S. Empress of Asia; includes descriptions of Yokohama and Tokyo; calling on Japan Air transport; mentions [Juan] Trippe.
